status_key_derivation: HMAC-SHA256 under the reconciler key over the ASCII bytes "ebs-recon-status-key"; readers hold the status key, and the tag is HMAC-SHA256 under it over "ebs-recon-status" and the body

layout.bound: a status is 80 + sum over its parts of (552 + 14 * rows) bytes; at 16 parts of 32 rows it is 16,080 bytes, within 16 KiB

wire.order: a status is the header, one part per zone in ascending zone order and the tag; a part lists its fields in wire order with their widths in bytes and is followed by its rows; every integer is big-endian

encodings.flags: one byte, bit k set when flag k of labels.flags holds
encodings.flagged: a flag byte then an 8-byte value: 1 carries the value, 0 with zero value bytes reads null; any other flag, or 0 with a nonzero value byte, refuses
encodings.members: a flag byte, used (8) and limit (8): 1 carries a reading with used at most limit, 0 with zero bytes reads null; any other flag refuses as a flag and used above limit as a field
encodings.label: one byte naming the k-th listed label at code k; a code past the table refuses
encodings.pair: a flag byte, used (8) and limit (8) read as independent values: 1 carries a reading, 0 with zero bytes reads null; the census and the recorded pairs are the two pairs

json_integers: every integer in a status view is an unsigned 64-bit value; a reader parses it losslessly, beyond 2^53

units.sealed_at_us: the writer's wall-clock stamp in microseconds since the Unix epoch, nondecreasing within a boot
units.sequence: the writer boot's status sequence, from 1, one per sealed status
units.writer: the status writer: the reconciler identity and the boot nonce its writer drew at start
units.writer.boot: the 16-byte nonzero nonce the writer drew at start, hex
units.writer.host: the reconciler identity, a nonzero 64-bit number the deployment assigns
units.zones: one part per zone the reconciler runs, ascending by zone number, at most 16
units.zones.attaches: the attach entries of the zone's active volumes on the tick, from their records, and the survey's closed shards by the cause it names
units.zones.attaches.closed: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the one host the survey judged: the census slot's host when the shard's slot decides, otherwise the lowest-numbered candidate that reached the attach check; the cell names that host's bound, which need not close every other candidate; for a host with a live attach the rule checks only that attach's key, entry-cap for an entry number with no key and key-taken for a key a recorded pair holds, and an enrolled pair passes; for a new attach it checks, in order, own-entry, live-cap, entry-cap for a full entry list, the next entry's key (entry-cap or key-taken) and pair-cap; a closed shard whose active volume no census reservation accepts, one neither fresh nor active or whose provisioned origin changed, carries no cause and counts in no cell, so in a status the survey builds the cells sum to at most zones.blockers.attach-closed; the decoder checks no relation between these counts
units.zones.attaches.closed.entry-cap: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the host the survey judged: entry-cap, for a new attach the volume's entry list is full with no gone entry the record can shed for the host, or the entry number the attach takes (the next entry's for a new attach, the host's live unenrolled entry's own otherwise) has no key
units.zones.attaches.closed.key-taken: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the host the survey judged: key-taken, a recorded pair holds the key of the entry number the attach takes: the next entry's for a new attach, or the host's live unenrolled entry's own
units.zones.attaches.closed.live-cap: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the host the survey judged: live-cap, the volume holds its most live attaches
units.zones.attaches.closed.own-entry: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the host the survey judged: own-entry, the host holds a retained ended entry, which blocks a new attach until reclamation marks it gone, or its latest event is a format-2 detach or force-detach, which blocks a new attach while that event stays the host's latest
units.zones.attaches.closed.pair-cap: shards in the survey's closed state by the first check of the attach rule that fails for the host the survey judged: pair-cap, the recorded pairs and the attaches awaiting enrollment reach the owner's pair cap
units.zones.attaches.ended_paired: ended entries that a recorded pair pins
units.zones.attaches.ended_unpaired: hosts whose latest entry is ended with no pair pinning it, an end awaiting its detach
units.zones.attaches.gone: hosts whose latest entry is gone
units.zones.attaches.pairs: recorded pairs, of the pair cap summed over the active volumes; used exceeds limit only when the zone's recorded pairs exceed the summed cap, and used at or below limit does not rule out one volume over its cap; null when the tick read no volume
units.zones.attaches.pairs.limit: the pair cap summed over the active volumes
units.zones.blockers: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most
units.zones.blockers.attach-closed: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: attach-closed
units.zones.blockers.census-full: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: census-full
units.zones.blockers.control-plane-unavailable: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: control-plane-unavailable
units.zones.blockers.correlated-hold: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: correlated-hold
units.zones.blockers.device-failure-hold: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: device-failure-hold
units.zones.blockers.headroom: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: headroom
units.zones.blockers.loss-unconfirmed: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: loss-unconfirmed
units.zones.blockers.no-eligible-host: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: no-eligible-host
units.zones.blockers.owner-not-ready: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: owner-not-ready
units.zones.blockers.per-host-cap: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: per-host-cap
units.zones.blockers.placement: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: placement
units.zones.blockers.quorum-unreachable: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: quorum-unreachable
units.zones.blockers.recorded-holder-hold: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: recorded-holder-hold
units.zones.blockers.replacement-exhausted: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: replacement-exhausted
units.zones.blockers.retirement-requested: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: retirement-requested
units.zones.blockers.self-suspect: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: self-suspect
units.zones.blockers.store-unavailable: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: store-unavailable
units.zones.blockers.volume-impaired: shards by the survey blocker of the tick, one per shard at most: volume-impaired
units.zones.budgets: the highest attempt counter and generation among the zone's shard records; null when the tick read none
units.zones.budgets.attempts: the highest attempt counter E, of 2^31 - 2
units.zones.budgets.attempts.limit: ATTEMPTS_MAX, 2^31 - 2; a reader refuses any other limit
units.zones.budgets.generation: the highest generation, of 2^32 - 2, the last a replacement can activate
units.zones.budgets.generation.limit: 2^32 - 2; a reader refuses any other limit
units.zones.census: the census length beside the configured cap; null when the tick could not read the census; a cap lowered below a census already written leaves the length above the cap, which the decoder accepts
units.zones.census.used: shards the census lists, at most 4096, which may exceed the cap
units.zones.classes: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count
units.zones.classes.blocked: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: blocked
units.zones.classes.cold: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: cold
units.zones.classes.fresh: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: fresh
units.zones.classes.recovering: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: recovering
units.zones.classes.served: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: served
units.zones.classes.silent: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: silent
units.zones.classes.withdrawn: shards of the zone by serving class on the tick; the classes sum to the zone's shard count: withdrawn
units.zones.events: the loop's event counts since it started, saturating at 2^32 - 1
units.zones.events.refused: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing
units.zones.events.refused.field: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: field
units.zones.events.refused.flag: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: flag
units.zones.events.refused.foreign: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: foreign
units.zones.events.refused.length: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: length
units.zones.events.refused.magic: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: magic
units.zones.events.refused.schema: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: schema
units.zones.events.refused.tag: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: tag
units.zones.events.refused.writer: host reports the loop refused, by kind; a duplicate delivery counts nothing: writer
units.zones.flags: the tick's source completeness, the survey's holds and the census cap flag, one bit each
units.zones.flags.cap-below: the configured census cap is below the zone's shard count
units.zones.flags.instances: the instance listing was whole on the tick and the loop admitted it, with no two differing rows for one tracked instance
units.zones.flags.operator: the operator zone hold held new attaches
units.zones.flags.reports: every zone host's report source answered on the tick
units.zones.flags.store: the tick read the census, every shard's records, every volume record the loss count looked up and every receipt it reread, a looked-up record or reread receipt the store answered with bytes that do not decode counting as read; when false, the counts the records decide (classes, standby states, needs, blockers, receipts, volumes, attaches, budgets and stale_serving) cover only the shards the tick read, and each unread shard reads silent with its standby unknown; a shard left unread by a store read failure adds one store-unavailable blocker, while a failed lookup or receipt reread alone leaves every shard read and adds no store-unavailable blocker, and a lost active volume can then read loss-unconfirmed, as it can with the flag true on a tick whose looked-up record or reread receipt does not decode: the volume of such a record counts nothing beside a loss, and a loss confirmed on an earlier tick keeps its hold only while the tick still counts another impaired volume; on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused, which reads all four source flags false, the loop reads no record, and every shard of the directory it last admitted reads silent and unknown with no blocker; a monitor reads a positive count on a tick with the flag false as proven by the shards read, and a zero as inconclusive
units.zones.flags.volumes: the volume listing was whole on the tick and the loop admitted it, with no two differing rows for one volume
units.zones.flags.warm-up: the survey held every step for warm-up
units.zones.flags.zone-host: the zone host hold held new attaches
units.zones.hosts: the zone's hosts on the tick; a tick whose directory read failed or was refused lists no host, so silent reads null and self_suspect and every verdict count read zero, which a monitor reads as inconclusive
units.zones.hosts.self_suspect: hosts whose last report advance lies within the fresh window and whose report's detector holds a self-suspicion dwell
units.zones.hosts.silent: hosts the directory does not retire whose last report advance is older than the fresh window or that have none, of those hosts; null with no such host, and on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused
units.zones.hosts.silent.limit: hosts the directory does not retire, at most 4096
units.zones.hosts.verdicts: hosts by the loop's verdict, every count zero on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused
units.zones.hosts.verdicts.conflict: hosts by the loop's verdict, every count zero on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused: conflict
units.zones.hosts.verdicts.live: hosts by the loop's verdict, every count zero on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused: live
units.zones.hosts.verdicts.lost: hosts by the loop's verdict, every count zero on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused: lost
units.zones.hosts.verdicts.unknown: hosts by the loop's verdict, every count zero on a tick whose directory read failed or was refused: unknown
units.zones.needs: shards by the need `standbys::need_of` gives them on the tick
units.zones.needs.fresh: shards by the need `standbys::need_of` gives them on the tick: fresh
units.zones.needs.standby: shards by the need `standbys::need_of` gives them on the tick: standby
units.zones.omitted: shards outside the served class and served shards with no standby past their target that the rows leave out; nonzero only beside 32 rows
units.zones.receipts: replacement receipts of a later generation than their shard record, by phase, and the held ones among them
units.zones.receipts.created: replacement receipts of a later generation than their shard record, by phase, and the held ones among them: created
units.zones.receipts.held: replacement receipts of a later generation than their shard record, by phase, and the held ones among them: held
units.zones.receipts.issued: replacement receipts of a later generation than their shard record, by phase, and the held ones among them: issued
units.zones.receipts.open: replacement receipts of a later generation than their shard record, by phase, and the held ones among them: open
units.zones.rows: at most 32 shards, each outside the served class or served with no standby past its target, oldest first and then by shard
units.zones.rows.age_us: microseconds on the loop clock since the loop first observed the shard in its class, and for a served shard first observed served with no standby past its target
units.zones.rows.class: the shard's serving class; served only beside the standby state past; a shard whose enrollment holds its census slot, or whose reservation the tick's plan admitted, reads enrolling at any exposure and takes no served row
units.zones.rows.shard: the shard number, a field and never a label
units.zones.stale_oldest_us: the longest time, in microseconds on the loop clock, that any counted stale entry has been observed stale; null when none is counted
units.zones.stale_serving: entries of fresh reports, whose last advance lies within the zone's fresh window, that read serving for a shard at a tenure below the shard record's, one per host and shard, each counted once the loop has observed the host claiming that same lower tenure for longer than the fresh window, a claim at another tenure starting a new dwell; a host the directory retires counts while its report is fresh
units.zones.standby: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot
units.zones.standby.enrolling: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot: enrolling
units.zones.standby.named: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot: named
units.zones.standby.past: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot: past
units.zones.standby.unknown: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot: unknown
units.zones.standby.within: shards by standby state on the tick; a shard that needs no standby is in no slot: within
units.zones.store.alarm: the store client's watermark alarm, the first cause that withdrew it
units.zones.store.outcomes: the store client's tallied outcomes since the zone loop took the client, summed over record classes, saturating at 2^32 - 1
units.zones.store.outcomes.log: the store client's tallied outcomes since the zone loop took the client, summed over record classes, saturating at 2^32 - 1: log
units.zones.store.outcomes.refused: the store client's tallied outcomes since the zone loop took the client, summed over record classes, saturating at 2^32 - 1: refused
units.zones.store.outcomes.unavailable: the store client's tallied outcomes since the zone loop took the client, summed over record classes, saturating at 2^32 - 1: unavailable
units.zones.store.outcomes.unknown: the store client's tallied outcomes since the zone loop took the client, summed over record classes, saturating at 2^32 - 1: unknown
units.zones.tick: the zone loop's tick count since the loop started
units.zones.unnamed_volumes: the listed volumes that read impaired or lost, hold a volume record short of retired and are named by no shard record or replacement receipt the tick read, such as a displaced volume whose retirement no process finished; null on a tick whose volume listing, census, shard records or volume-record lookups were incomplete; the active volume of a shard the directory omits counts here while it reads impaired or lost
units.zones.volumes: the zone's active volumes by the loop's health judgement; unknown when unjudged
units.zones.volumes.available: the zone's active volumes by the loop's health judgement; unknown when unjudged: available
units.zones.volumes.impaired: the zone's active volumes by the loop's health judgement; unknown when unjudged: impaired
units.zones.volumes.lost: the zone's active volumes by the loop's health judgement; unknown when unjudged: lost
units.zones.volumes.unknown: the zone's active volumes by the loop's health judgement; unknown when unjudged: unknown

resets.per-tick: every field outside zones.events and zones.store.outcomes holds the value of the part's tick
resets.zones.events: the loop's start: counts rise from zero when the status writer's process starts the zone loop, whose first tick is 1
resets.zones.store.outcomes: the zone loop's construction, which takes the store client's tally then as the count's zero, before the loop's tick 1

writer.boot.rule: a count of zones.events or zones.store.outcomes rises from zero when its zone loop starts, which takes the store client's tally then as the zero of zones.store.outcomes, at the loop's tick 1, and the loop's tick rises by one per tick. A monitor reads the statuses of one (writer.host, writer.boot) in sequence order and ignores a status at or below the highest sequence it holds of that boot. It forms deltas within one (writer.host, writer.boot, zone): the first part it holds of that zone rises from zero when its tick is 1 and is the baseline otherwise, so a monitor that starts within a loop counts no event from before its first part; a later part whose tick is below the last tick held starts a new loop, and each of its counts rises from zero; a count that falls restarts that count, rising from zero, whether or not the tick rose. A writer that restarts a zone loop or its store client within its process draws a new boot nonce first, so every counter restart inside one (writer.host, writer.boot) is a fault of the writer; the tick and fall rules detect such a restart only through a lower tick or a fallen count

tick.rule: every other field holds the value of the status's tick and forms no delta
